top_signals.title: Kpler Sees Oil Grinding Higher as Diesel Crunch Deepens
top_signals.summary: Kpler’s Matt Smith expects oil prices to keep grinding higher, with six and a half months of Middle East supply losses now working their way through gasoline and diesel prices. Smith told CNBC Thursday that oil prices have risen roughly $30 per barrel since early August. Gasoline would normally be falling at this point in the year as summer driving demand fades. It isn’t.
